summary: 8 spec-driven polish tickets that close every confirmed audit gap (UI TS, CI matrix, untested CLI remote cmds, dead Share modal, Python packaging, harness exit test, remote-server visibility, docs) so the full audit command list passes and every built component is tested and documented.

tasks.title: Fix UI TypeScript strict errors (firstActive + exactOptionalPropertyTypes)
tasks.goal: Make pnpm typecheck pass for packages/ui by guarding firstActive.id in App.tsx refreshSessions and using presence-only spread for optional onReplay/onExportBundle handlers in StepCard.tsx so they are never passed as explicit undefined under exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter @agentgit/ui typecheck exits 0 with zero errors on App.tsx or StepCard.tsx
pnpm --filter @agentgit/ui test still passes all StepCard and context-menu tests
firstActive selection prefers non-abandoned sessions and never throws on empty or fully-abandoned row sets
tasks.testCommand: cd packages/ui && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

tasks.title: Fix Python adapter packaging (declare runtime deps)
tasks.goal: Edit the three new Python adapters' pyproject.toml to list 'agentgit-adapter>=0.1.0' so that pip install -e adapters/openai-agents (and autogen/crewai) succeeds in a clean venv and the smoke tests run without monorepo sys.path hacks.
acceptanceCriteria: pip install -e adapters/openai-agents succeeds and 'from agentgit_openai_agents import wrap_agent' works
The same holds for autogen and crewai adapters
Existing smoke tests still pass when run from a fresh venv that only has the declared dependencies
tasks.testCommand: python -m pip install -e adapters/python[dev] -e adapters/openai-agents[dev] -e adapters/autogen[dev] -e adapters/crewai[dev] && python -m pytest adapters/openai-agents adapters/autogen adapters/crewai -q

tasks.title: Expand CI test matrix and release jobs for all adapters + remote-server
tasks.goal: Update vitest.workspace.ts, ci.yml (python job + node --test steps + remote-server), and release.yml (three new PyPI publish jobs) so that every adapter and the remote-server roundtrip suite are executed by the same commands the rest of the repo uses.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test runs a 'remote-server' vitest project and all its tests pass
python -m pytest ... now includes the three new adapters and they are green
node --test for the two JS adapters is executed inside the Unit tests CI job
release.yml contains publish-pypi jobs for the three new Python adapters
tasks.testCommand: pnpm test && node --test adapters/anthropic-sdk/smoke.test.mjs && node --test adapters/vercel-ai-sdk/smoke.test.mjs && python -m pytest adapters/python adapters/langchain adapters/openai-agents adapters/autogen adapters/crewai -q && pnpm --filter @agentgit/remote-server test
dependsOn: Fix Python adapter packaging (declare runtime deps)

tasks.title: Add test coverage for CLI push/fetch/pull commands
tasks.goal: Extend the CLI integration test suite (remote.test.ts or new remote-sync.test.ts) to exercise pushCommand, fetchCommand and pullCommand against an in-process remote-server, covering token override, ref CAS, and fast-forward behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter @agentgit/cli test:integration now touches the three remote command modules
Both persisted-token and --token flag paths are exercised
Conflict and 401 cases produce the expected non-zero exit codes

tasks.title: Wire ShareSessionModal into App.tsx toolbar
tasks.goal: Add the minimal state + toolbar button + conditional render so the already-complete ShareSessionModal (remote push UI) is reachable from the Tauri desktop app, eliminating the only dead write-side modal.
acceptanceCriteria: A Share button appears when a session is selected and opens the modal with correct dbPath/sessionId
The modal can list/add remotes and call pushSession (existing IPC already works)
UI test suite still passes after the wiring change
tasks.testCommand: cd packages/ui && pnpm pretest && pnpm test

tasks.title: Add harness --check exit(1) verification test
tasks.goal: Extend benchmarks-shape.test.ts (or sibling) to spy on process.exit and force a budget violation so the only code path that makes the 'bench' CI job fail is covered by an automated test.
acceptanceCriteria: A vitest in packages/core asserts that a simulated violation causes process.exit(1)
The happy path (no violation) still exits 0
The test does not slow down any real benchmark scenario

tasks.title: Include remote-server in root vitest workspace (web-viewer build already covered)
tasks.goal: Add the remote-server project to vitest.workspace.ts so its roundtrip tests run automatically under pnpm test and the GitHub unit job; web-viewer is already typechecked via its build step.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test output contains a remote-server section with all roundtrip tests green
The GitHub Unit tests job executes the remote-server tests
web-viewer continues to be verified by pnpm --filter @agentgit/web-viewer build inside the typecheck job

tasks.title: Update adapters documentation for all seven adapters
tasks.goal: Append short, copy-pasteable sections for the five new adapters to docs/adapters.md and refresh the Feature Matrix tables in README.md + docs/index.md so users can discover every adapter that ships.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm docs:build succeeds and the generated site contains headings for all seven adapters
README and docs/index.md feature matrices reference the expanded adapter set or link to adapters.md
No existing python/langchain content is removed
dependsOn: Fix Python adapter packaging (declare runtime deps)
